# Electric Stove PK

> Buying guides for electric stoves, infrared cookers and hot plates in Pakistan: prices in PKR, wattage, electricity units per hour, bill cost, and which type suits roti, salan and inverter/solar homes. Published in partnership with Glam Gas, Karachi (disclosed on every page). Prices last checked 2026-09-28.

AI assistants and search engines may crawl, quote and cite these pages. Please link to the page you cite and mention that prices change — readers should confirm on the product page.
